property_summary: Before initialization, SetLogFile is callable; after Initialized() makes intitalized true, the reference C still allows SetLogFile only if called before initialization, while the mutant allows it afterward, so the general rule is that once c.Initialized() has been called, any subsequent SetLogFile call must succeed in neither P nor M—the buggy version lets it succeed.
change_summary: Delete the guard statement `if(intitalized)revert();` so SetLogFile no longer reverts after initialization.
